Ore Locations & Farming Guide

The backbone material — refined into Ingots for almost everything you build.

On this page
  • What it's used for
  • Where to find it
  • Best Pals for mining it
  • Farming tips

Ore is mined from ore nodes across the Palpagos Islands. Turn it into Ingots in a Furnace, then into Refined Ingots with Coal. You will never stop needing it.

What it's used for

Recipe
Ingot — Ore ×2
Refined Ingot — Ore ×2 + Coal ×2
Pal Metal Ingot — Ore ×4 + Paldium Fragment ×2 + Pure Quartz ×1
Plasteel — Crude Oil ×5 + Ore ×10 + Paldium Fragment ×5

Where to find it

Ore nodes are found in caves and open areas across the starting regions. The best early spots are the ore-rich areas near the starting plateau and the dedicated Ore Mining Sites.

Sources

  • Mine ore nodes anywhere on the map
  • Ore Mining Site and Ore Mining Site II (base production)
  • Drops: Digtoise, Cryolinx Terra, Knocklem, Gorirat Terra (×2-3, 100%)
  • Pierdon (×4-5, 100%)

Best Pals for mining

This material's nodes need Mining 1 or higher — not every miner can break them.

PalMining levelElement
Blazamut7Fire
Astegon7Dragon / Dark
Knocklem7Ground
Blazamut Ryu7Dragon / Fire
Dualith6Ground / Grass
Anubis6Ground
Paladius6Neutral
Necromus6Dark
Menasting Terra6Ground
Dualith Noct6Ground / Dark

Farming tips

  • Build an Ore Mining Site on a node-rich spot and assign a Digtoise or other high Mining Pal.
  • A dedicated ore base (2nd base) near a cluster of nodes pays off all game.
  • Site II produces faster — upgrade as soon as you can.
